cohort: The study included 1773 neonates whose mothers were referred for first-trimester fetal chromosomal anomaly screening.
finding: In neonates delivered at or beyond 37 weeks of gestation, first-trimester PAPP-A MoM values significantly predicted RDS occurrence, with a cut-off value of 1.02 showing 72.41% sensitivity and 91.84% specificity.
gest_age: Included neonates delivered at or beyond 37 weeks (n=28) and less than 37 weeks of gestation (n=42), with the primary finding focused on those at or beyond 37 weeks.
